Gold Query: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRLINES AS T3 ON T3.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" AND T3.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

Frage: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der United Airlines-Flüge, die in Aberdeen ankommen.
Generierte Query: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE destairport = 'Aberdeen' AND airline = 'United Airlines'
Gold Query: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRLINES AS T3 ON T3.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" AND T3.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

Frage: Welche Stadt hat die meisten ankommenden Flüge?
Generierte Query: SELECT city FROM airports GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(airportcode) DESC LIMIT 1
Gold Query: SELECT T1.City FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.DestAirport GROUP BY T1.City ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
